name: doc-decision-memo
description: Writes a Decision Memo with the question in one line, options with evidence, a recommendation, a reversibility call, who decides by when and a signature line. Use for "run doc-decision-memo", "write the decision memo", "get sign-off that sticks", "we keep reopening this decision", "lay out the options for the VP", "one-way or two-way door", "who is the approver here", "decision doc for leadership", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
